integrity: A symbolic proof establishes the infinite parameter classification. Exhaustive and independent finite verification supports but does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact two-position attractor list assumes all four positive run lengths are at least two; the minimum-cardinality phase theorem includes length-one runs.
No classification is asserted for all minimum size-three attractors or words with five or more alternating runs.
Novelty assessed against inspected primary sources and available records; independent priority confirmation is outstanding.
title: Exact attractor size and pair geometry of four-run binary words
